perQuestion.question: What is Within Health and what problem does it solve?
perQuestion.answer: Within Health is a radiology follow-up management platform. The problem it solves is ensuring that important findings and follow-up recommendations in radiology reports are not missed or delayed.
perQuestion.expectedAnswer: Within Health is a radiology follow-up management platform that ensures important findings and follow-up recommendations in radiology reports are not missed or delayed. It uses AI and NLP to identify recommendations and automates communication with patients and referring physicians.
perQuestion.context:
[Project: Within Health | Section: Overview] Overview Within Health is a radiology follow-up management platform developed to help ensure that important findings and follow-up recommendations in radiology reports are not missed or delayed. The platform uses AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) to identify follow-up recommendations from radiology reports and track them through their required follow-up period. It helps radiology practices manage these recommendations and automate communication with patients and referring physicians through reminders and outreach. The system provides visibility into the complete follow-up process from identifying a recommendation to tracking its status and confirming that the required action has been taken. By helping close this communication and care loop, the platform aims to support timely follow-up, early clinical action, and better patient outcomes.
